data.title: 管理员 · 早起把温牛奶放到你手边
data.description: 清晨家中餐桌前，管理员穿浅灰金边棉质家居套装，双手捧着温牛奶放到你手边。她的面部露出，短发尚有一点睡醒后的蓬松，带着浅浅笑意看你；身后的窗帘刚拉开。
data.action: 双手将温牛奶杯放到镜头近处，抬头微笑
data.lighting: 窗帘打开后的清晨柔光
data.promptProse: With her face uncovered and short hair still slightly tousled, the Administrator sets a warm glass of milk beside the viewer's hand using both hands. Her pale-gray cotton pajama shirt has fine gold piping and a closed front. The eye-level medium view includes the home dining table and newly opened curtains behind. Soft morning light rounds the glass and highlights her smile, leaving quiet shadows in the pajama folds.
